per_view_pixel_findings.findings: Complete raised cottage, steep side-gable roof, centre entrance, paired windows and chimney fit with margin. Source six-light 3x2 upper sashes now appear above single lower panes.
Front and end construction continue around the corner: clapboard, trim, real openings and supported steps. No exposed gable penetration or bright QA patch occurs on the roof.
Both roof slopes, one bounded ridge, source-position chimney and full footprint are coherent. No roof shard, slot, lighting patch or floating foundation was seen.
Roof plan, ridge direction, chimney offset and both entry projections are fully framed. Source top is correctly limited to high-aerial evidence, not a survey.
Complete foundation-to-ridge gable has physical main/attic openings and corrected six-light upper sashes. Gable is covered by the roof underside.
Complete end elevation and chimney termination have neutral margin. Source-specific lower and attic sash depth remains intact; no blank or unfinished secondary face was found.
Paired six-light upper sashes, distinct glazed-upper rear door and grounded three-step entry retain the rear source hierarchy.
Rear and gable construction continue through the roof, supports and entry. Chimney penetrates its carrier. No roof/gable or lighting regression was seen.
Real returns, recessed sash/pane and occupied depth remain visible. Upper horizontal muntins now match source. Six-panel front door and supported entrance are retained.
Gable carrier is covered by the roof underside and bounded rake. Dark soffit reads as shaded overhang. Attic opening has returns, six-light upper sash and enclosed depth.
Cut carrier, recessed sash/pane and offset furniture/room depth remain visible. This tight optical close is not used as full-stair proof.
Three native front treads visibly bear at grade and meet the sill. Amended threshold is 0.53 m, with tread levels about 0.176667, 0.353333 and 0.53 m.
Original side-context camera remains partly occluded by sofa and ceiling. Preserved honestly; not accepted alone as full-flight or endpoint proof.
Occupied attic, bed, floor cut and guards are inspectable under adequate light. Arrival bridge reaches the solid floor and previous dark 0.19 m slot is gone. Guard-foot finish is P2.
Chimney positively intersects continuous roof carrier and has a seated cap. No inspection-light patch or carrier slot appears. Flue/flashing remain clay simplifications.
Added exact-GLB view exposes complete supported tread run and lower-floor bearing, with handrails, physical floor cut and upper arrival direction. Paired upper views close top-floor contact.
Added close shows a continuous landing-to-floor surface around a real stair opening. Previous unsupported exit strip is absent. Minor guard-end/foot separation is recorded as P2.
